reason: The plugin is primarily a DSH development extension that adds a live headless Cocos preview and inspector into the DSH UI, and links selected scene nodes back as agent context for project edits. Its documented tools (`kurenai_preview_*`, `kurenai_project_*`) and workspace-rooted operation show the main purpose is plugin-based development workflow support with local file and runtime orchestration rather than general content generation or knowledge tasks.

summaries.zh: Kurenai 是一款 DSH 插件，在会话旁提供 Headless Cocos 实时预览和运行时检查器，并可将场景节点选择转为上下文用于在当前 Cocos 工作区继续编辑项目文件。
summaries.en: Kurenai is a DSH plugin that adds a live Headless Cocos preview and runtime inspector beside chat, turning selected scene nodes into context for editing the active Cocos workspace.

capabilities: Edits and updates files in the active DSH workspace Cocos project
Starts, stops, checks status of, and coordinates a local Headless Cocos preview process
Provides a web client inspector overlay integrated into the DSH interface
Captures scene-node selection/context from runtime preview and maps it for agent use
